mapper.sql: CASE WHEN A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CC', 'CK', 'SBD') THEN SUBSTR(A.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) WHEN A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') THEN SUBSTR(A.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) WHEN A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('SC', 'SR') THEN SUBSTR(A.PSG_FCLT_CD, 5, 1) ELSE ' ' END
mapper.select: /* CastFcltMapper.retrieveFcltMapList */ SELECT A.PSG_FCLT_CD AS PSG_FCLT_CD, NVL(A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, ' ') AS UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, /* 상위 행이 없는 코드가 있어 이름은 비워 둔다 — 서비스가 시설구분 이름으로 채운다 */ NVL(P.PSG_FCLT_NM, ' ') AS UP_PSG_FCLT_NM, NVL(A.PSG_FCLT_NM, ' ') AS PSG_FCLT_NM, NVL(A.PSG_FCLT_EXPLN, ' ') AS PSG_FCLT_EXPLN, /* 미매핑은 빈 문자열로 내린다 — 화면이 null 과 '' 를 나눠 다루지 않게 한다 */ NVL(A.SMLT_FCLT_NM, ' ') AS SMLT_FCLT_NM, AS ISLAND, NVL(A.SORT_SEQ, 0) AS SORT_SEQ, NVL(A.USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN, NVL(A.LAST_MDFR_ID, ' ') AS LAST_MDFR_ID, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT A LEFT JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT P ON A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = P.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TMNL_ID = #{fcltTmnlId} /* 상위코드가 곧 자기 자신인 그룹 행은 매핑 대상이 아니다 */ AND A.PSG_FCLT_CD != NVL(A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, ' ') ORDER BY A.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, NVL(A.SORT_SEQ, 0), A.PSG_FCLT_CD
